summary: Phase 4 tests (seller tools + Reorder). Backend: a new pytest suite with 29 tests passes 29/29: upload/serve, categories, products CRUD with stock and visibility, delete 409, coupons (dup 409, inactive, expired, category limits, redemptions, used_count), settings, map validation, temporarily-closed checkout block, hours, holidays, zones, policies, testimonials, logo, audit, admin 401/403, CSRF. Frontend (Playwright on the public URL): admin products, coupons, settings tabs, logo in navbar, testimonials on home, policy page, audit page and the customer Reorder flow were all checked by hand. One HIGH frontend bug: Reorder only adds the LAST line of a multi-item order to the cart. Owner settings were restored exactly; seed product 1 was accidentally deleted by the tester and then restored with its original ids (see seed_data_creation).

minor.issue: Pydantic validator errors (bad map link, bad logo URL, 5-digit PIN, bad image_url) return 422, not 400. There is no RequestValidationError handler. The UI message is still correct because errMsg strips 'Value error,'.
Store logos are saved under the icepops/products/ path. Cosmetic: a separate logos/ prefix would be better.
The audit target is only the numeric id, not the date or PIN, so the audit log entry is hard to read.

ui_bugs.issue: Reorder of an order with several lines adds only the last line. Reproduced: order IP261107-A4EF62 had 2x Strawberry Cheesecake Cone and 1x Kala Khatta Ice; after Reorder the cart held only 2x Strawberry Cone. Cause: order.items.forEach(i => add(...)) calls add/setQty, which read `items` from the render closure. Each call rebuilds the list from the same stale array and overwrites the previous one.

issues: No way to remove or clear an uploaded logo (ImageUpload only has 'Change image'). logo_url can only be reset through the API.
Unticking 'Temporarily closed' hides the message input but keeps the old closure_message saved (harmless but stale).
Expiry text 'expires 31 Dec, 11:30 pm' leaves out the year. Confusing when the expiry is next year.
Uses the browser's built-in date, time and datetime-local pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the Reorder multi-item bug. Add addMany(lines) to CartContext using a functional setItems(prev => ...) merge, then call persist once. Or change setQty/add to functional updates. ReorderButton should then call addMany(order.items).
Add a 'Remove logo' button to the Business tab (set logo_url null). Optionally add a Remove button to the product image too.
Optional: map RequestValidationError to 400 if a 400 contract is wanted; show the year in the coupon expiry; clear closure_message when reopening; use shadcn date pickers.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext add/setQty use the stale `items` closure, so several updates in one tick lose data. This is the root cause of the Reorder bug and would hit any batch add.

DELETE /admin/products relies only on the order_items check. It hard-deletes seed products with no orders (cascades cart_items and inventory_movements) after a single window.confirm. Consider soft-delete or a stronger confirmation for products that have movement history.
_apply_variants deactivates removed variants instead of deleting them. Good for order history.
Coupon IST handling in the UI is correct ('+05:30' is appended and shown back in IST).
Upload checks the content-type, magic bytes and the 5MB limit. /api/files is served only for registered UploadedFile rows. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all seller-tool flows work; Reorder loses items for multi-line orders)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_phase4_seller_tools.py -n 0 -v. It snapshots the settings and restores them in the module teardown. Use snapshot_settings.py <out.json> before and after, plus diff_snapshots.py a.json b.json, to verify restoration. Creating files in /app/backend/tests triggers a backend hot reload (wait about 4s). NEVER click product-delete on seed products in the UI: no seed product has orders, so it really deletes. After the Reorder fix, retest by placing a 2-line order for a TEST customer (p4_helpers.py order <email>), clicking reorder-<number>, checking that both lines are in /cart, then cancelling.
rca of the issue: Reorder: ReorderButton calls add(variant_id, qty) for each item in one event handler. add() → setQty() computes `rest = items.filter(...)` from the render-time `items`, then persist(next) → setItems(next). Each call replaces state with stale items plus one line, so only the last call survives. Repro: an order with 2+ distinct variants → Reorder → the cart has only the last variant. Fix: a functional update (setItems(prev => merge(prev, lines))) with a single debounced PUT /cart.
